package.description: Validate GeoParquet files against the OGC abstract tests and the 1.0/1.1 community specifications

en-US.description: Validate GeoParquet files against the OGC abstract tests and the 1.0/1.1 community specifications
en-US.longDescription: A single command that runs the abstract tests of the OGC GeoParquet 2.0 draft on a file, a directory or an object-store URL, checks GeoParquet 1.0 and 1.1 files against their own community specification, and reports the distribution best practices as advice.
en-US.name: GeoParquet Validator
